senses.gloss: pr. n. m. (an adaptation of πανεγυρίστης) Pangar (Encomiast), name of one of the generals (duces) before Jerusalem under Vespasian.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:31">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>חד אמר קילוס שמיה וחד אמר פ׳ שמיה</he> one says, the name of that dux was Ḳillus (Praise), and one says, his name was Pangar.
